scenes.title: UT Austin & Nara Sleep Timing Comparison: 9:00 PM Warm Shower Radiator Runway vs 10:50 PM Trapped-Heat Toss

layout.description: Clean architectural cutaway connecting a softly steamed tiled bathroom to an airy, cool-lit bedroom: at 9:00 PM a 54-year-old adult steps out of a 10-minute warm shower in a breathable cotton robe, letting warm palms and feet radiate heat into the cool room before drifting effortlessly to sleep at 10:30 PM.

positions.who: 54-year-old adult (in breathable waffle-weave cotton robe stepping onto bathmat)
positions.where: turning off the brushed-nickel warm shower valve with ninety minutes to spare before bedtime
positions.facing: stepping from steamed shower into cool airy hallway

positions.who: Sleep biomedical researcher (in crisp Oxford shirt holding non-contact thermal camera viewer)
positions.where: observing the glowing warm-hand/foot radiator shift as core chest warmth drops steadily toward pillow time

props.name: brushed-nickel thermostatic shower dial and misty glass door
props.period_detail: 10-minute 40–42.5 °C passive body heating window 90 minutes pre-bed
props.physical_behavior: State-A dial turned to warm steam for 10 minutes at 9:00 PM -> State-B clicked off as glass door slides open into cool evening air

props.name: analog bedside clock and crisp breathable linen duvet
props.period_detail: tracks the 90-minute post-bath heat-dissipation runway to lights-out
props.physical_behavior: State-A hands pass 90 cooling minutes -> State-B adult slips smoothly under cool linen and falls asleep rapidly

actions.verb_sequence: clicks off the warm shower valve, steps into the cool bedroom hallway in a light robe -> settles onto the pillow 90 minutes later with calm, slow breathing
traces palm-and-foot heat release driving the downward core-temperature sleep trigger

reactions.reaction: exhales with effortless heaviness as cooled core temperature unlocks fast sleep onset
nods confirming the 60-to-120-minute distal radiator window

scenes.wardrobe: Oatmeal waffle-cotton robe and soft sleep shirt; navy chinos and rolled Oxford sleeves on researcher.
scenes.lighting: Warm amber bathroom steam transitioning into crisp, cool dusk bedroom lighting.
scenes.recognition_hook: Ten minutes of warm water ninety minutes before bed opens hand-and-foot radiators that cool your core right on schedule.

key_visual.description: an adult stepping out of a warm steamed shower into a cool airy bedroom hallway ninety minutes before bed while hands and feet radiate warmth

scenes.title: Outdoor Evening Porch Cool-Down: Fresh Night Air Accelerating the Post-Bath Thermal Drop
scenes.era: Modern quiet suburban evening wooden back porch

layout.description: Quiet twilight cedar back porch overlooking garden trees where a 58-year-old adult in a light cardigan sips herbal chamomile tea after an early-evening warm bath.

positions.where: standing calmly by the wooden porch railing in crisp evening air letting warm palms cool gently
positions.facing: looking out across the peaceful dusk garden

props.name: ceramic mug of caffeine-free chamomile tea and cedar porch thermometer
props.period_detail: cool evening air pairing with dilated peripheral skin vessels
props.physical_behavior: State-A sets warm mug down on cedar rail -> State-B relaxed shoulders drop as crisp night breeze completes the 90-minute core cool-down

actions.verb_sequence: sets the ceramic mug on the porch railing, breathes in cool dusk air, and turns smoothly indoors toward the dark bedroom

reactions.reaction: serene, unhurried drowsiness arriving naturally before 10:30 PM

scenes.wardrobe: Soft knit cardigan over cotton loungewear.
scenes.lighting: Deep twilight blue sky with subtle warm porch sconce.
scenes.recognition_hook: Warm skin meeting cool evening air creates the exact downward core-temperature slope your brain reads as bedtime.
